name: Hizuki Ayaka
source:
Ayaka is [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url] and [url=/c7879]Yue[/url]'s childhood friend and is [url=/c7882]Minamo[/url]'s cousin. She maintains a kind and well-mannered, but timid personality.

She dies in a car accident before the events of the first game.
